about: The master opener LLM warm template (operator 2026-10-16: "copy the song folder template, and make it a master opener LLM warm template"). Copy this folder to <number>_<name>/ and give it its own song_id. Played by Wire-Pod (gopod_opener_song.go), not by pha0b. Kept in _new_song/ (operator 2026-10-16: "would make sense to put songs/_llm_warm/ folder in _new_song folder"). Notes: warm_message (the System llm bubble's message, shown and said; "wait_voices": true waits for the voice files before it's said), warm_wait (waits until the language model is loaded), reporter_lines (the reporters' in-between lines), warm_ready (the ready message, shown and said), sting (the system sting, settings reporter_voices.system_stings.default). Every step: "volume": "" (chat_audio.volume, the master) or a percentage of it ("50%"), on its voices and stings (operator 2026-10-16: "add volume, default or %age").
